question: Can even immense jewel-filled wealth equal the value of this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is invoked as immense wealth
Such wealth is described as beyond purchase
The verse poses this as a measure of incomparable value
inference: Even an ocean full of priceless jewels cannot match the teaching's value
uncertainties: The token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is morphologically compressed and partly unclear
plain_english: Even if one possessed an ocean filled with jewels beyond price.
